ENERGY Adequate energy intake is important in order to 
prevent catabolism and achieve optimal nutritional status. 
Suﬃ  cient kcal from carbohydrates and fat may help to prevent
muscle and visceral protein from being utilized as energy. Th e
energy recommendation from the K/DOQI Nutrition Guide-
lines is based on the ﬁ nding that energy expenditure is similar 
to or slightly higher than that of healthy persons.23 Following 
these recommendations has been shown to provide neutral 
nitrogen balance and the maintenance of both serum albumin
and anthropometric parameters. A lower caloric requirement
has been shown to be adequate for older persons who are more
sedentary. Caloric requirements should be adjusted accordingly 
for those with higher activity levels, those who are under-
weight, and those who display catabolic stress.27
